d:
My first ever comic!!!

How would your Girlfriend react if she saw you looking at other girls in your internet search history? Probably lose it right? Not Jessi! She understands that her boyfriend who she lives with (Eric) works is ass off in order to pay the bills and support her! Now she has an idea to make his life a little easier and better! To take inspiration from what she's seen in his search history and without him knowing, give him what he desires! Question is... Will this work out the way Jessi thinks it will?

Updates will be weekly!
